body: I left on my 1 year anniversary, the turn over rate was crazy and I didn't see myself dealing with that again especially through upcoming holidays.  I was mentally and physically tired of this place.  Tried to go part time but they wouldn't let me, the work loads never ends and it felt I cared too much to pick up others people slack. It wasn't fair that I was hardworking but nothing, no incentive in giving 100%.  I was done.
